title: KAITO — I Can't Sit Back〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's rare of you to come talk to me like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know, but Luka's been having fun jerking you around.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Is that why you're here...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So, tell me.
Are you here to also yank my chain?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe Rin's being so stubborn because of what Luka said...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After you and Rin finished arguing at the lake, Luka said...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “I should see if I can smooth things out between them.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Take it with a grain of salt.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was planning on just watching from afar since you sowed these seeds...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I recommend you nip this in the bud while you can. Otherwise, it's all going to work out in Luka's favor.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't know what Luka told you, but I'm guessing she wasn't telling you the truth.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For now, can you tell me what she said?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, why do you have such a serious expression on your face?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO eavesdropped?
Shame on him.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: On the other hand, it might've been his way of saying you wouldn't be able to handle this situation.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially considering how heavy and complicated Kanade's sins are...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She basically said that you're treating me with kid gloves...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But wouldn't apologizing to her be the adult thing to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Look who's talking.
Doing what she said would've meant throwing gas on the fire.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you really think I'm that kind of person...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you really think I'd take pity on a kid by thinking something would be too much for them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's doing everything she can to destroy who you really are. How can you even think about showing her any mercy?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, come on. Open your eyes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know exactly what she's trying to do. But you just keep—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, you wouldn't...
Because you're as cold as ice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm just not soft-hearted like the rest of you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Anyway, now do you understand?
Luka pulled a fast one on us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We made up? This was all your doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but you wouldn't have even tried talking to Rin if I hadn't done anything.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Luka...
There's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I have to get going now.
I just remembered that there's somewhere I need to be.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So...
Rin and KAITO made up?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: At the very least, their misunderstanding has been resolved.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (There's never a dull moment with this lot...)
